text:
Marta G: Planning note: third-party engagement scheduled with NightRaven. Focus areas: RBAC around KMS, audit log fidelity, and incident triage playbook. Window: 2025-07-02 09:00-17:00 UTC. Need to finalize assessor role scoping and evidence retention. @Sanjay R please propose proxy ACLs, @Jess L please confirm SIEM immutability, @Ryan T please propose retest and triage SLAs.

Sanjay R: I'll own ephemeral role provisioning. Requirements: decrypt-only, explicit denies for Encrypt/GenerateDataKey, deny secrets write. Use kms-proxy that injects x-pt-id and returns structured audit JSON. Draft ACL below.

Jess L: We'll set SIEM index retention to 90 days and mark immutability for 10 days. Also adding a saved search to filter on x-pt-id and request_id. We need one copy of raw logs exported at end-of-window for chain-of-custody.

Marta G: Remediation policy: each fix must include a PR with fix, a regression test that replicates PoC (if applicable), and a short ops-runbook entry showing how to verify. Retest only after QA signoff.

Ryan T: Triage cadence proposal: ack within 6 hours; high/critical patch within 72 hours (block deploys if exploitable); medium within 10 business days. Retest schedule: reserve 2-hour slots the week after fixes are merged. OpsBot will issue ephemeral creds once the window opens.

OpsBot: ephemeral role created: assessor-nightraven-20250702 ttl=6h issued_by=@Marta G. SIEM index created: pt-nightraven-20250702.

Sanjay R: ACL snippet:
```
{
  "role": "assessor-nightraven-20250702",
  "allow": ["Decrypt"],
  "deny": ["Encrypt","GenerateDataKey","CreateKey"],
  "audit_fields": ["request_id","key_id","caller","x-pt-id","pr_ref"],
  "require_header": "x-pt-id",
  "token_rotate_minutes": 60
}
```
Will also add middleware to attach pr_ref if assessor includes it in header.

Jess L: I'll file ticket INF-SIEM-812 to update retention and export. Adding immutable flag for 10 days and a scheduled export to secure storage at EOD.

Marta G: Good. Also require assessors to sign an NDA and agree to scoped test cases. Ops take care of issuer flow.

Ryan T: Adding oncall escalation: if a critical PoC exists, page infra-oncall and pause deploys to affected namespaces until fix verified. We'll publish a short runbook for that.

Sanjay R: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/kms-proxy/pulls/450. Contains ACL template and tests for audit emission. Tagging @Jess L @Marta G for review.

Jess L: Ticket created: https://tickets.redwood.dev/INF-SIEM-812. Export schedule set to S3 path: s3://redwood-pt-exports/nightraven/20250702.

Marta G: Next steps: Sanjay finish PR, Jess complete SIEM export + saved search, Ryan publish triage runbook and retest calendar. Dry-run scheduled Tue 2025-06-30 14:00 UTC to validate audit lines include request_id, key_id, x-pt-id, and pr_ref.

Sanjay R: Sample audit line to include in PR: {"time":"...","request_id":"r_xyz789","key_id":"alias/main","caller":"assessor-nightraven-20250702","x-pt-id":"NR-20250702-01","pr_ref":"infra#450"}

Jess L: I'll make sure saved search filters on x-pt-id and that immutability state is visible in console.

Ryan T: I'll block retest buckets on calendar and notify product/infra leads.

Marta G: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Fri 16:00 UTC for final dry-run verification. :thumbsup:
